regions.title: Eastern Sierra
regions.text: Mammoth is forecast for about 24", 19" of it Tuesday. The National Weather Service has heavy snow at Mammoth Monday night and Tuesday. The NWS is calling for more at Mammoth: 22 to 37 inches Sunday night through Tuesday night.

regions.title: Cascades
regions.text: Mt. Bachelor is forecast for about 25". Crystal Mountain and Mt. Baker follow. The National Weather Service has rain mixed in at Crystal Mountain Monday.

regions.title: Tahoe
regions.text: Kirkwood is forecast for about 21", 12" of it Sunday. Palisades and Sugar Bowl follow. The National Weather Service has heavy snow at Kirkwood Monday night and Tuesday.

regions.title: Northern Rockies
regions.text: Jackson Hole is forecast for about 10". Grand Targhee and Sun Valley follow. The NWS is calling for more at Jackson Hole: 18 to 37 inches Friday through Tuesday night. Winter Storm Warning at Jackson Hole from Friday to Saturday.

regions.title: Northeast
regions.text: Le Massif is forecast for about 9". Mont-Sainte-Anne and Jay Peak follow. Environment Canada has rain mixed in at Le Massif Friday night. Freezing Rain Warning at Le Massif from Friday to Saturday.

regions.title: Central Rockies
regions.text: Steamboat is forecast for about 7", 5" of it Saturday. Crested Butte and Arapahoe Basin follow. The NWS is calling for more at Steamboat: 6 to 13 inches Friday night through Tuesday night. Winter Storm Warning at Steamboat from Friday to Sunday.

regions.title: Coast Mountains
regions.text: Whistler is forecast for about 6", 3" of it Monday. Cypress Mountain follows.

sources.name: NOAA buoys 51001 / 51101 (method: Powder Buoy, Mike Ruzek)

buoy.text: Buoys 51001 and 51101 near Hawaii popped Nov 25, the swell signal Powder Buoy watches for a Wasatch storm about two weeks later — here Dec 6–12. In past winters a pop raised the chance of a Wasatch storm in that window by roughly 6 to 12 points. Experimental: promising, not proven.
